msg: Hello, I'm from Norway and I have my Open Water certification. I want to do the Advanced course from Cartagena. How long does it take, how many dives, and what is the price?
reply:
Hi! 🪸 I'm *Coral* from *Diving Planet* — we dive year-round in the Rosario Islands, departing from Cartagena or right from the islands. 🌊

The Advanced course from Cartagena takes *2 days* and includes *5 dives*: four specialty dives and one night dive. You’ll need to stay overnight on the islands; accommodation isn’t included. I’m leaving the price details below. Would you like to continue with the booking?

*Prices per person* (online · regular):
*From Cartagena* — boat from Muelle de la Bodeguita · lunch on the first day
• PADI Advanced Course: 616 USD · 685 USD
*Already on the Rosario Islands* — pickup at your hotel if it has boat access · no lunch
• PADI Advanced Course: 529 USD · 588 USD

msg: Yes, from Cartagena please. I would like to do it on January 22 and 23. My last dive was in Thailand in April this year. Do I need to study something before?
reply:
Yes—after enrollment, you’ll receive digital course materials and access. It’s important to complete the knowledge reviews before the dives. Your Open Water certification meets the prerequisite, and your last dive in April was less than two years ago, so the usual refresher requirement doesn’t apply.

The course takes two days and requires at least one night on the Rosario Islands; accommodation isn’t included. The price is *USD 616 online* or *USD 685 regular*, per person. January 22–23 is a lovely plan, though the team would need to confirm availability for those dates. You’ll also need to present your certified diver card.

You'll also need:
• The medical form is required for courses or mini-courses: https://form.jotform.com/divingplanetcartagena/exoneracion-curso-en-espanol (the form is in Spanish). The link can be sent together with the booking link; if you have not completed it, it is sent again in the booking confirmation email. Exception: the refresher (a review with an instructor) uses the course medical form, even if you are a certified diver.
• To process the insurance, you must complete the form we send in the booking confirmation email.
• After diving, wait at least 18 hours before flying
• Minimum age: 12 and over.
• What to bring: swimsuit, towel, sunscreen, sunglasses and comfortable clothes. Diving or snorkeling gear is included in dive trips, the mini-course, snorkeling and PADI courses; the Divemaster uses their own gear.

How many people would this be for: just you, or more? 😊

msg: Just me. How can I book and pay?
reply:
As an international guest, you’ll pay 100% by card on the website, using your passport as your ID. The 10% online discount is applied automatically. Your payment is recorded right away, then the team reconciles it shortly after to confirm the booking. If the online payment fails, the team will send you a bank-transfer payment link, and the 10% online discount will still apply. Outside that case, payment by transfer isn’t available.

🤿 *PADI Advanced Course*
💰 *616 USD* per person (online rate)
📚 PADI course: dates, sessions and details are arranged with you.

👉 *For more information and to book, click here:*
https://book.divingplanet.org/book/advanced-course/5?language=en

Guests who are not Colombian or residents of Colombia pay in US dollars (USD) by card on the website; the rate is the same, only the currency changes.

Is there anything else I can help you with? I can *add another activity*, answer questions, or adjust your booking. 🤿
